title: Chapter 737 - 737 Defense; Expedition!
content:
Chapter 737 - 737 Defense; Expedition!

Chapter 737 - 737 Defense; Expedition!

737 Defense; Expedition!

Lin Fan spent three days to teach Ma Zhong a King level skill.

Only then did the soul communication end.

Then, he turned his attention to the system.

“System, can Earth’s defensive array block the ocean universe?”

[Requires 1 million spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

“Yes.” Lin Fan said without hesitation.

[Sure.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, he asked,”What kind of power can Earth’s current defensive array withstand?””

[Requires 10 million spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

“Yes.” Lin Fan said.

[Able to resist 10 Holy Lords, all of them attacking with their full strength for 100 years.]

Lin Fan’s heart tightened.

It could only withstand 10 Sacred Lords ‘full-power attacks for 100 years.

What if 20 of them came?

What if they attacked 1000 years?

There was still danger!

It had to be reinforced!

And so, Lin Fan placed a lot of Spirit Stones and Immortal Crystals around the world in a specific way.

Then, he quickly drew a talisman.

In the following period of time, a very strange scene appeared on the entire Earth.

Rings of strange talismans spread out in all directions. When they covered the entire sky, they seemed to melt and disappear in an instant.

At first, many people were surprised.

Some people took photos as mementos, some posted on their Moments, and Weibo was the top trending topic for a long time.

However, as time passed, everyone became accustomed to it.

In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed.

Lin Fan finally stopped.

He looked at the 15 overlapping protective barriers on the surface and revealed a satisfied expression.

“15 defensive arrays. Even if 10 Sacred Lords come, it will take 1500 years to break through. After 1500 years, I should be at the Sacred Lord realm. At that time, killing a few Sacred Lords won’t be difficult.”

Lin Fan’s words were so casual.

If 10 Sacred Lords really came, who would continue attacking after their attacks were ineffective?

Furthermore, it was 1500 years ago!

Even if the other party really had such perseverance, it was impossible for him to have the ability to continue erupting.

To reach the Holy Lord state in 1500 years, Lin Fan was probably the only one who would dare to say such a thing.

One had to know…

Lin Fan was only a King level 8 cultivator.

If he wanted to become a Holy Lord, there was still a small realm of the King realm and a whole realm of the Emperor realm.

Not to mention the huge gap between the King level and the Emperor level, countless people could not cross it in their lifetime.

Just talking about it, if an Emperor level expert wanted to break through a minor realm, it would take tens of millions of years.

As for breaking through to the Saint Lord realm, that was not something Nian Yue could calculate.

However, Lin Fan wanted to use 1500 years to reach the Holy Lord state.

If others knew about this, they would definitely say that Lin Fan was bragging.

Sometimes, the truth would shut everyone’s mouth.

….

On this day.

A star-like, sci-fi looking spaceship appeared in the center of the ocean universe.

A large group of uniformed soldiers stood neatly in front of the spaceship. From afar, they looked like dense ants.

At this moment, a dazzling golden light landed in the sky.

In the golden light, a nine-headed flood dragon wearing a royal robe slowly appeared.

All the warriors knelt down and said loudly,”” Greetings, universe master!”

The nine-headed flood dragon’s sharp eyes swept across the warriors and said,””The ocean universe is vast and boundless, invincible!”

“Of course, there are people who killed my Heavenly King and destroyed my elites. What do you think we should do?”

“Kill!” the soldiers shouted in unison.

The momentum was vast and shook the heavens and the earth.

The nine-headed flood dragon nodded in satisfaction and said,”That’s right, kill!” We will flatten 5901 and conquer the Spring Field, spreading the name of our Ocean Universe!”

“We will flatten 5901, conquer the Spring Field, and spread the name of our Ocean Universe!”All the warriors said in unison.

“Let’s go!” the nine-headed flood dragon said.

“Ta Ta Ta!”

The soldiers walked towards the spaceship in unison.

The spaceship started, and golden light shone brightly. It was like a star that streaked across the sky, attracting the attention of countless people.

The ocean universe master’s personal expedition had officially begun!

….

Now, Lin Fan had prepared everything that he needed to.

He seemed very calm.

Today, he had gathered with everyone in the Coiling Dragon Villa. They were having a barbecue and chatting at the same time. It was extremely comfortable.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Level 1 King Realm cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level two King Stage cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 3 King Stage cultivator detected.]

….

[Ding! Level 9 King Realm cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 4 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator detected.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his brows twitched as he stood up abruptly.

Could it be that the marine universe army had arrived?

He quickly raised his head and looked up into the sky with his Heavenly Eye.

Lin Fan had come into contact with the Ocean Universe twice before and knew that they were all fish heads and human bodies.

But now, why was the person in the sky with a human head and a human body?

Lin Fan frowned.

The only fortunate thing was that under the observation of the Heaven’s Eye, other than the cultivators at the fourth level of the Imperial level who only had a dozen fatal weaknesses, the rest of the people were covered in countless weaknesses that he could easily resolve.

Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, and the others also sensed Lin Fan’s abnormality. They asked,” Lin Fan, what’s wrong?”

Lin Fan smiled and said,” It’s nothing. We just had some guests.””

At this moment, a loud and clear voice reverberated throughout the entire Earth.

” Star Master Lin Fan, I’m the Four Seasons Universe’s Great Elder. I have something to discuss with you. Can I have a chat with you?””

Lin Fan heard that and smiled,” Look, there are guests, right?” I’ll go over and have a chat first.”

As he spoke, he cast a reassuring look at everyone.

Then, he took a step forward and instantly disappeared.

….

In the void.

Dozens of battleships gathered together.

A large group of men and women with powerful auras stood in the air, looking at the earth from afar, and occasionally let out a burst of discussion.

“Is this 5901? As expected, it contained a large amount of spiritual energy!”

“I’ve never seen so many spirit dragons in my life!”

“I really don’t know what the situation on this planet is like.”

“Unbelievable!”

….

In fact, not only were the experts who had come to Earth for the first time astonished, the Wood Lord Qin Xian was also astonished.

This was because the Earth today had undergone a huge change compared to a few decades ago. The spiritual energy was even denser.

Generally speaking, the spiritual energy on a planet was fixed, and the number of cultivators was constantly increasing.

This caused the spiritual energy on the planet to decrease over time.

However, the number of planets was increasing in violation of the law?

What was going on?

The First Elder, who had been silently observing Earth, said,””Someone is coming.”

As soon as he finished speaking, ripples suddenly appeared in the distant space like water.

Then, a tall and handsome figure slowly appeared.

It was… Lin Fan!
